mission_04: For the relation module, concatenate query and support: combined = np.concatenate([query, support]). Then apply: h = ReLU(W1 @ combined + b1), score = sigmoid(W2 @ h + b2).
For classification, compute prototypes (mean embeddings per class), then compute relation score between query and each prototype. Predict the class with the highest score.

For the loss, collect relation scores for all classes into a vector, apply softmax, and compute cross-entropy with the true label. sigmoid(x) = 1 / (1 + exp(-x)). For embedding, apply: embed = ReLU(W @ X + b).
